C1469.title: Cyberattack on German Steel Plant Causes Physical Damage
C1469.summary: A German steel plant suffered an advanced persistent threat attack in which threat actors used spear-phishing emails to infiltrate the office network and subsequently breach the production network. The attackers gained access to the blast furnace control system, preventing a proper shutdown and resulting in significant physical damage.
